title: AI That Learns Atomic Forces Is Changing Materials Research
summary: An energy function trained on many materials provides a starting point for calculating a new crystal’s vibrations. A small model gives different frequencies at the same energy minimum, while an actual study finds different relaxed phases after identifying the same unstable mode. Following what must be validated anew and which records must be preserved shows how pretrained models and the calculation procedures that AI agents reassemble can become shared research resources.
